conditions: reference_building_id must be one of the four proposed reference buildings
hazus_terrain_class is required (open, light_suburban, suburban, light_trees, trees); no default, no interpolation
tc_peak_gust_3s_10m_mph is the open-terrain 3-second gust at 10 m; terrain is applied only by the record choice
records are valid from 50 to 250 mph; below 50 returns 0, above 250 withholds
only the reference wind building characteristics are published (the Hazard profile value where it states one, else the most common); other values withhold
the damage ratio includes wind pressure, windborne debris and rain entering through wind damage; no separate debris or rain pathway may be added
scenario dollars stay withheld until the consumer qualifies the building value
Canonical scope: exact warehouse, office and house bindings; retail remains conditional source evidence without annual binding.

prerequisites: Exact per-profile whole-building value and source pin
Explicit open, suburban or trees condition; no local mapping or probability weight asserted
Native current STORM parent; open-terrain three-second gust at 10 m converted exactly once
Native spatial mixture before annual metrics; original source/unresolved-tail mass retained
Installed annual frequency/cap/tail/convergence proof and national readback before delivery

checks_required: record routing by reference_building_id and hazus_terrain_class
terrain never defaulted and never also applied to the gust
wind and flood damage on one building in one storm together at most 100% of structure value
cap_binding.action_if_fail: withhold the affected DR or downstream metric; do not substitute another record or clamp

required_before_canonical_use: Unchanged source response admission for owner-requested warehouse/office/house reference scope and three explicit terrain conditions; annual use remains conditional on consumer prerequisites.
